label: FreeSurfer mri_tessellate
description:
Tessellate a labelled volume at an explicitly selected label.

The interface exposes the typed options listed below; the original installed-version help is retained in source references.

parameters.label: label
parameters.usage: Label value to tessellate. Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.

input_slots.label: labels
input_slots.description: Input image. Choose an existing file; the command never modifies it.

output_slots.label: surface
output_slots.description: Native command output, saved in this run’s output directory. Tessellate a labelled volume at an explicitly selected label. This generic file port does not establish a specialized scientific artifact type; downstream use must match the documented contents, not merely the filename extension.

omitted_options.other_options: Only the documented options below are exposed. Consult the installed-version help for other syntax; arbitrary arguments are not accepted.
